name: Truco Mineiro
summary: Loud Brazilian partnership trick-taking game where 4 players compete for best of three tricks with bluffable stake-raising.
rules_text: Four players in two fixed partnerships opposite play with a 40-card deck (8s,9s,10s removed) where 4c>7h>As>7d>3>2>A> K>J>Q>7>K... are ranked. Deal 3 cards each after the hand may burn or pass up to three 3-card sets. Hand leads trick 1 counter-clockwise; winner leads next. Any card may be played; tricks 2-3 may be played face-down to never win but save. Tied highest cards from opposite sides ties the trick: first team to win a trick then wins the hand. Before or during tricks a team may call "Truco" to raise the hand from 1 to 3 tentos, opponents may accept, fold, or re-raise to 6, 9, 12. Private gesture signals between partners about their hands are allowed and discussed privately beforehand; vague verbal talk about hand strength is allowed but naming cards is forbidden. First partnership to 12 tentos wins match.
rating_reason: Specific 4-player partnership trick-taking with bluffing and betting.
